title: Selection-biased pooled OOF ranking diagnostic — NOT operating-point validation
authorization: Parent requested summary of fixed existingOOF scores only after seeing model results. No refit, new features, modelparameterchange, or fresh validation.
case_score: min(current/prior mean leaf RAW p), with originaleligibility/confidenceguards; guards reject even if threshold=0.
threshold_selection: One common >=threshold across all five OOF folds. Pooled labels used to choose descriptive thresholds; these results are optimistically selected and NOT valid estimates for a deployable operating point.
tie_handling: All cases at an identical score enter together; ties are never split usinglabels. No interpolation or fractional cases.
